title: Prakriti Herbal — Herbal & Natural Products
tagline: An earthy herbal store with a wellness kit builder, fully working in your browser
description: The customer side of Prakriti Herbal, a Dhaka shop for herbal oils, ayurvedic supplements, natural teas, handmade soaps and essential oils: filter by wellness need, a kit builder that picks one product per shelf within your budget, wellness kits with the real saving, a journal, best-before dates on every product — and the disclaimer next to every product's traditional-use notes. This is the shop's real code running in the browser — orders you place here appear in the Prakriti Herbal admin demo.
highlights: Kit builder: pick a need and a budget, get one product from each shelf
Wellness kits list what's inside and the real saving
No medical claims: the disclaimer sits on every product page
Checkout fills Division → District → Upazila with a live delivery fee by zone
Phone check at checkout: the SMS code appears on screen in the demo
Every confirmed order gets an invoice number and a PDF invoice
Coupons PRAKRITI100 and KIT10 work at checkout
Orders you place show up in the admin demo — it is one working system
Optional shopper sign-in: 01700000001 / demo12345 — nothing is charged or delivered, and ?demo-reset starts fresh
